notes.title: 《怦然心动的她们》手游版 预约开启！参与活动赢好礼
notes.content:
感谢各位玩家一直以来的关注和支持，轻科幻真人互动恋爱影像《怦然心动的瞬间》手机版本现已开启预约，参加预约活动得好礼。进入官网预约可参与预约活动，赢取预约礼品。

官网网址：http://prxd.kunyuworld.com/ （请将链接复制到浏览器打开）

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021452/dadd41ea0d32f52af028995d929b2b7b5adaddf5.jpg[/img]

[h2]一、活动简介：[/h2]

[h3]活动一：预约即送，章节兑换券等你来领[/h3]
进入官网首页登录后点击“立即预约”按钮即可预约成功，预约可得小心心*5跑车*1章节兑换卷*1
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021452/f0b6bc2b8e288bb5762a3bec4c72a04449796bf0.png[/img]

[h3]活动二：达成预约目标，累计心动值获得奖励[/h3]
玩家预约成功即可贡献心动值，共五档奖励：
1w—小心心*10、一捧玫瑰*5 
5w—一捧玫瑰*5、跑车*1 
10w—小心心*20、跑车*2 
30w—一捧玫瑰*5、跑车*2
50w—抖动一号*1、章节兑换卷*1
玩家可在公测后创建的第一个账号内领取对应礼包奖励。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021452/87870b62ed2087f4dfa1d24c7287941af6bbecf0.png[/img] 
[h3]活动三：邀请好友收集心动值，解锁豪华补给品[/h3]
    通过专属链接邀请未预约好友，预约成功完成集结目标，心动守护者可在公测后90天内创建的第1个账号中，领取对应礼包奖励。

邀请一位好友—跑车*1、章节兑换卷*1
邀请三位好友—一捧玫瑰*10、抖动1号*1
邀请五位好友—抖动一号*1章节兑换卷*1
邀请七位好友—章节兑换卷*1实体相框签名照兑换卷*1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021452/eb1da702011599576f2a159ae99f3cdd31afe732.jpg[/img]
 

[h2]二、全新玩法，焕然一新的恋爱体验[/h2]

[h3]■ 全新结局，“恋爱后”的甜蜜生活[/h3]
和女主确定恋爱关系后，你又将与心爱的她发生怎么样的化学反应？手机版在原有的剧情的基础上进行了改编，并加入了全新的故事结局，相信一定能让你感受和“她”不一样的心动瞬间。

[h3]■ 新增道具系统，收集和“她”的所有心动瞬间[/h3]
推进剧情的过程中，你将获得各式各样的隐藏道具，收集来自不同女主的特殊道具可以解锁她们为你录制小视频、精美照片等特殊彩蛋。

[h3]■ 为她打call，心动榜单系统[/h3]
随着剧情的展开，根据您的选择，将获得小心心、一捧玫瑰、抖动一号等心动道具，这些道具可在心动榜单中为您喜爱的女主进行投票，为她打call。

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021452/d7d27fc1fa28916c47143c368797635a58635d2a.png[/img]

最后再次感谢大家一直以来的陪伴与支持，您对我们的支持就是最好的激励，希望能与各位心动守护者在怦然心动再次相遇~

更多精彩内容，欢迎加入手游版官方QQ群（群号613093711）获取最新情报。

notes.title: “怦然心动的重生” 联合捆绑包发售
notes.content:
什么？我重生了？重生之后我一定不能再被爱情蒙住双眼，我要做出一番事业！
可是……她们还是不可避免的让我怦然心动，这一次，我该怎么选择呢？

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021452/bd77ae0e615bdced5a138c1b0dae2704ce456b4b.png[/img]

[h2]一、折扣活动：[/h2]

    《怦然心动的她们》和《重生了还要我谈恋爱》在玩家的热烈呼唤中联手合体啦。
    自即日起，购买“怦然心动的重生”捆绑包即可享9折优惠，已有一款游戏游戏加购另一款也可享受折扣。 


[h2]二、	视频二创活动：[/h2]

即日起至8月31日，玩家在「抖音/B站」平台发布二创视频，并@怦然心动的她们 和 @重生了还要我谈恋爱 两个官方账号，并填写作品链接至在线文档，即可成功报名。

报名地址：
【腾讯文档】怦然心动的重生二创活动收集表
https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DQmJVRlJjUFJOcVl0

或扫描下方二维码进行报名填写↓↓↓：
 
数据回收截止日期为8月31日12时，活动结束后，官方将按照点赞量对报名作品进行排名，各自平台各自统计。
奖项设置：
一等奖：抖音/B站各3名，以数据回收时各平台点赞量前三的作品为准。
    奖品为双方演员亲签一套（6+6），《怦然》钥匙扣*6，《重生》钥匙扣*6
二等奖：抖音/B站各7名，以数据回收时各平台点赞量4-10名作品为准。
    奖品为双方演员印签一套（6+6），《怦然》随机钥匙扣*3，《重生》随机钥匙扣*3
三等奖（参与奖）：报名参加活动但未获得一、二等奖的全部玩家。
    奖品为双方演员印签随机各3张（3+3），《怦然》随机钥匙扣*3，《重生》随机钥匙扣*3
特别奖：双方官方将联合根据剪辑内容、技术等多方面因素，选出一位剪辑内容最优秀的作品作者，为其颁发神秘礼品！

[h2]三、其他说明：[/h2]

1. 发布的二创作品必须同时包含两个游戏的内容、画面。
2. 作品发布的时间必须为2024年8月8日11时之后。
3. 同时在两个平台发布作品的作者，只统计排名较高的平台作品，另一平台名次向后顺延（举例：玩家A抖音排名为第3名，B站排名为第1名，则获奖名单中只按B站排名计算，抖音不计名次，并向后顺延一位）
4. 发布的内容不得包含有悖于祖国利益、违反法律法规、违反公序良俗、影响社会和谐的内容；不得发布包含地域歧视、种族歧视、煽动对立及人身攻击的内容；不得发布与双方游戏毫不相关的内容。凡违反上述规定的，一经发现，将取消该用户的活动资格。

notes.title: 20% discount is coming, join the event to get new 'Summer Love' signature photos
notes.content:
Summer is coming, and the hot wind of love is sweeping towards us. In the past two months since the release of "Charming Hearts", we have received strong demands from many players who "want peripherals!" in players' "special reviews". So, based on valuable suggestions from players, the developer team collaborated with the game actors to create the most popular "Summer Love" swimsuit version with autographed photos, and decided to launch an 20% discount promotion. Participating in the limited time event will earn you free rewards for signature photos and merchandise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021452/31ee93e61a217267b2e1924f61413ff6063bb4c8.jpg[/img]

[h3] [Event Time] [/h3]

[b] From July 30th to August 13th (a total of 14 days) [/b]

[h3] [Activity 1: Collecting likes and receiving signed photos on WeChat Moments] [/h3]

During the event, players can choose any platform on QQ space, WeChat Moments, or Weibo to post wallpapers about their heart pounding excitement. Attached is the following text:

Summer is coming, heading towards passionate love. Portal: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2817140/_/ [/b]”

Successfully receiving 30 likes is considered a successful participation.

By presenting screenshots of your Moments, Steam ID, and in-game purchase receipts on Steam, you can join the official Q group (group number 703617235) and contact the group owner to receive one new version signature photo (default random, if you want to specify a character's signature photo, you can make a wish to the group owner, limited quantity, first come, first served).

Note: In the like event, the same person who participates in the like event on multiple platforms or using multiple Steam IDs can only receive it once.

[h3] [Activity 2: Heartbeat Transmission, Invite Friends to Receive Signature Photo Gift Pack] [/h3]

During the event, inviting friends to purchase games is considered successful participation.

Old players can obtain one handwritten photo of the new version by contacting the group owner and joining the official Q group (group number 703617235) with a screenshot of successful purchase and Steam ID. (Random by default, if you want to specify a character's signature photo, you can make a wish to the group leader, limited quantity, first come, first served)

New players who have been invited to join the official Q group (group number 703617235) can contact the group owner and provide their corresponding Steam ID, purchase and game records to receive one set of new version signed photos (6 in total).


[b] Attention: [/b]
1. An old player account can be linked to up to 6 new players (Steam IDs), and the Steam ID of an invited new player can only be linked to one old player account
Players who purchase the game before the start of the event on July 30th can participate in the Heartbeat Transmission activity as "old players"
Players who purchase and activate the game between July 30th and August 13th are eligible to participate as invited 'new players' in the event




PS: The rewards for this event will be shipped within one month after the end of the event. If you encounter any problems, please join the official Q group (group number 703617235) and contact the group owner for assistance.



Thank you all for your companionship and support. Wishing you all a long and fulfilling love.

notes.content:
Dear Heartbeat Guardians:

Good morning, noon and evening~! First of all, thank you for your support for "Charming Hearts". Amid everyone's expectations, "Charming Hearts" is finally officially launched! At everyone's request, we have prepared autographs and limited peripherals of the actors for you. Without further ado, let's get straight to the point!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021452/13d354fecfa9c83d6c014fa70c95a73ea9b8bd09.png[/img]

[h3]Event time: June 14-June 28, 2024[/h3]

During the event, if you publish works that meet the requirements of the event rules, you can get a large number of game peripheral rewards such as "Heartbeat Autographed Photo", "Heartbeat Autographed Photo Set", "Heartbeat 40*90cm Mouse Pad" and so on.

[h1]Activity Rules[/h1]

[h2]Bilibili[/h2]

[h3]【Participation Method】[/h3]

1.Guardians can publish game strategies, reviews, live broadcasts, etc., or re-edit and draw game content. Text, pictures, and videos are all acceptable. There is no limit to the type or style.

2. Submitted videos must be tagged @怦然心动的他们 (official account) in the video introduction of Bilibili

3. Join the official group 1: 703617235, contact the administrator in the group QQ: 3769947272 to register with screenshots and video links.

[h3]【Event Rewards】[/h3]

1. By the end of the event, the top 20 players with the most video views will receive a "Heartbeat Autographed Photo Set" (containing 6 non-duplicate character photos, with the same character photos randomly distributed)

2. By the end of the event, the top 10 players with the most single video views will receive an additional "Heartbeat 40*90cm Mouse Pad" peripheral

[h2]TikTok[/h2]

[h3]【Participation Method】[/h3]

1. Guardians can post game guides, reviews, live broadcasts, etc., or re-edit and draw game content. Text, pictures, and videos are all acceptable, with no restrictions on type or style.

2. Post a video containing the topic "#悸然心动的他们" and @悸然心动的他们

3. Join the official group 1: 703617235, contact the group administrator QQ: 3769947272 to sign up with screenshots and video links.

[h3]【Event Rewards】[/h3]

1. By the end of the event, the top 20 players with the most video views will receive a "Heartbeat Autographed Photo Set" (containing 6 non-duplicate character photos, with the same character photos randomly distributed)

2. By the end of the event, the top 10 players with the most single video views will receive an additional "Heartbeat 40*90cm Mouse Pad" peripheral

[h2]Live Broadcast[/h2]

[h3]【Participation Method】[/h3]

1. During any three days of the event, broadcast live on any live broadcast platform such as Bilibili, Tiktok, Douyu, Huya, etc., and the duration of each live broadcast must be more than 60 minutes

2. Join the official group 1: 703617235, contact the group administrator QQ: 3769947272 to register with a screenshot and live broadcast link

[h3]【Event Rewards】[/h3]

1. Successfully participate to receive a "Random Heartbeat Autographed Photo Gift Pack" (randomly includes 3 autographed photos of the protagonist), limited to 50 copies, first come first served.

2. The top 10 players online at the same time will receive an additional "Heartbeat 40*90cm Mouse Pad" peripheral

Note: The above 3 activities can be participated in repeatedly, and the rewards can be superimposed

[h2]Creation Requirements[/h2]

The content published by the guardians shall not contain content that is contrary to the interests of the motherland, violates laws and regulations, violates public order and good customs, and affects social harmony; it shall not publish content that contains regional discrimination, racial discrimination, incitement to confrontation and personal attacks; it shall not publish content that is completely unrelated to this game; it shall not obtain rewards through improper operations such as continuous brushing, repeated deletion, etc.

Anyone who violates the above regulations will be disqualified from the event once discovered, and  reward will be postponed to the next person.

Thank you for your attention and support, and I wish you all love and get what you want!

All developers of the "The Girls Who Fell on Love" project team

notes.title: Closed beta test end and optimization direction of the early access version
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, this closed beta test has been successfully completed yesterday! Thank you for your support and contribution to the game optimization.
The full version of the game will be released as scheduled on June 10, and all game content including Chapter 7 will be unlocked at that time.
We have recorded and adjusted your suggestions one by one. The following is a list of some improvements:[/b]

[h3]Optimized content before Early Access:[/h3]

1. Fix the image quality. We will add a 2K DLC package (no more than one week, expected to be around 50G) after the official version is launched and provide it to all players who have purchased the game for free.
2. Fix the problem of the game volume fluctuating.
3. Optimize the game operation experience and reorganize the hotkeys.
Spacebar pauses/plays the screen without calling out the menu;
ESC key calls out the menu + pauses the screen;
Enter key skips the completed replay clips;
Tab key supports page turning in the plot line interface;
4. Added setting functions, including: setting volume, volume switch, setting window/full screen mode, and adding 1080P/2K image quality switching for users who have downloaded the DLC package.
5. Optimized support for background operation.
6. Optimized the judgment method of the plot line and some nodes, so that you don’t need to start over. Only after making a new choice at a specific node, you can unlock the remaining plot clips along the new plot line.
7. Optimized the required value of favorability for passing some chapters.
8. Optimized the numerical difficulty of each heroine to achieve perfect favorability.
9. Modified click sound effects.
10. Fixed bugs such as the inability to skip the bottom clip, channel error, and UI occlusion.
11. Improved the verification tolerance of filling in the birthday in the interview questionnaire.
12. Optimized the appearance rules of each chapter title at the beginning of the chapter to avoid overlapping with other game interfaces.
13. Added mobile phone-album function to collect photos of the heroines.
14. Built-in function prompts for other APPs in the phone.

[h3] Contents that will be updated after the early access is opened: [/h3]

1. The current plot line is highlighted

2. Some chapters have plot connection issues

3. Scene interaction can achieve digital selection

Looking forward to seeing you on June 10th, all members of the project team wish you all love and finally get what you want

Charming Hearts Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021452/80980a031691d3f57d1967ef2d301c052120e38f.png[/img]

You can purchase and unlock the early access version on the Steam store page.[/h2]

[h2]The early access version contains all current game content, and you can get a 20% discount if you purchase it within 2 weeks of the launch.[/h2]

2024.05.30
Charming Hearts development team[/h2]

notes.title: "Puppy Love" Test Qualification Announcement

notes.title: Recruitment Announcement of "Charming Hearts"
notes.content:
Dear Heartbeat Guardians

First of all, thank you all for your support of "Charming Hearts" (hereinafter referred to as "Heartbeat"). With everyone's anticipation, the "Heartbeat" project is about to enter the closed testing phase. I believe everyone is very concerned about how to obtain the activation code for this closed test. Without further ado, let's take a look at the content of this event together!

[b] Event time: May 21, 2024 to May 28, 2024 at 24:00;
Announcement and distribution of award list: May 30, 2024;
"Early Love" closed test period: May 31, 2024 12:00- June 2, 2024 12:00, (three days in total) [/b]

[h1] Activity Content 1: [/h1]

[h3] [Activity Platform] [/h3]
Station B, Tiktok

[h3] [Activity Rules] [/h3]
During the event, after forwarding the official video on any platform and adding "Heartbeat" to the wish list, forward the "activity video" and leave a message with the code "Apply for Early Love". Add the customer service representative's QQ account (3769947272) and send the corresponding screenshot, which is considered as a successful participation in the event.

[h3] [Activity Rewards] [/h3]
We will randomly select players who have completed the task to become the lucky guardians of this closed test, and distribute 30 test qualifications through private messages.

[h3] [Activity Video Link] [/h3]

Bilibili:
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Nx4y1W7v4/?spm_id_from=333.999.0.0

Tiktok:
https://www.douyin.com/user/MS4wLjABAAAAvRkOx1G9ttOvUNIVq_xQ4KkmZpv-eoWMEchjTq_W4H8V8CGfEmRMnEfVo3_HFrv8?modal_id=7369250376312163621


[h1] Activity Content 2: [/h1]

[h3] [Activity Platform] [/h3]
QQ group

[h3] [Activity Rules] [/h3]
During the event, guardians can use official videos, images, secondary editing, painting creations, or make bold guesses about the actors and character plots you expect. Text, images, and videos are all available, with no restrictions on type or style. If the playback/reading volume exceeds 500 on any platform, or if the cumulative number of secondary creative works published exceeds 5, join the official group 1: 703617235. Contact the group administrator QQ: 3769947272 to receive rewards.

[h3] [Activity Rewards] [/h3]
After the event, we will rank based on the content created, and the top 10 guardians will become the lucky guardians for this closed test, along with an activation code for the preemptive experience version.

[h3] [Creative Requirements] [/h3]

The content published by all guardians shall not contain content that is contrary to the interests of the motherland, violates laws and regulations, violates public order and good customs, or affects social harmony; Content containing regional discrimination, racial discrimination, incitement of opposition, and personal attacks shall not be published; Do not publish content unrelated to this game; It is not allowed to obtain activation code rewards through improper operations such as continuous floor scrolling and repeated deletion.
Any violation of the above regulations, upon discovery, will result in the cancellation of the user's activity qualification and the issuance of a closed test activation code reward will be postponed by one person.
	
[b] Note: The same player can participate in activities 1 and 2 repeatedly, but can only obtain one activation code at most. The obtained activation code cannot be resold or added to others, and can only be used by the recipient themselves. The list of winners will be based on the user ID at the time of publication. [/b]


Thank you to all the guardians of Heartbeat for your attention and support. Let's make an appointment this May and see each other again!


All developers of the project team for "The Heartbroken Women"
♥ 2024.5.21 ♥
